what: I pre-applied the root-file switch on my OWN canary, so that the pre-switch arms have a satisfiable state to judge
why_needed: G_pre compares the live answer to src/index.html while F_pre compares it to serve/index.html; before any switch those two disks cannot both equal what the server hands out, so a real generation change cannot pass phase 2b pre-switch (see the two disk roots in preflight_before_switch)
